question: In a certain code language, GRAPES is written as 66. How will PRAISE be written in the same language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e66f4f82443dd9c3e35396b7118d1ba1cf51fe787f48a3685c3dc4cf5d4be8d0.png] 

**Sum of alphabet positional values.**

GRAPES is coded as 66 :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ee5975d71dd97df8c5fd7158ae06c98319e39dfe735f33908d2fe129c95d0a3.png] 

⇒ 7 + 18 + 1 + 16 + 5 + 19 = 66

Similarly,

PRAISE will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bc8cc99c1706ebe1a36616dee2ff9a7e4b2801f6ba307aa2be5976c5a01baff.png] 

⇒ 16 + 18 + 1 + 9 + 19 + 5 = 68

Hence, the correct answer is **"68".**
